issue_snapshot.body:
Deferred from #33 by its work order: the shared 404 (app/not-found.tsx) stays shell-less and session-blind by TR-3 design, so forbidden and missing reads stay indistinguishable.

## Acceptance (from the split)

- **IAC-1** Signing in lands on Home, never on Profile; every signed-in page shows the app shell top bar with Tabs mark linking Home, current place, and account menu opening Profile and Sign out.

Part of #31.
Depends on #33.
